Rules

ID: monster-thunderclap

Action: Maneuver

One hearing creature within 2 squares gains Deafened 1. Once per turn; no damage.

Only creatures whose entries list this ability possess it. Printed limits apply.

Creature procedure · @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.da-rules.JournalEntry.fcfeb03f877503a3.JournalEntryPage.743fa3bd946d24fb]{Monster ability index}

The blow jars loose a thundercrack that rolls back across the space between them.

Rules

ID: monster-thunderous-answer

Action: Reaction

After an attack resolves and deals HP damage to this creature, its visible attacker within 3 squares gains Deafened 2 if it can hear this creature. This creature must survive and remain capable. No trigger from a free attack or another retaliatory effect. No damage or interruption of the resolved attack.

Creature procedure · @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.da-rules.JournalEntry.fcfeb03f877503a3.JournalEntryPage.743fa3bd946d24fb]{Monster ability index}

ID: monster-tunnel-scamper

Creature procedure · @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.da-rules.JournalEntry.fcfeb03f877503a3.JournalEntryPage.743fa3bd946d24fb]{Monster ability index}

A small turn of the wrist catches the blow on a waiting edge and sends it sliding past.

Rules

ID: monster-turn-the-blade

Action: Reaction

Before one adjacent enemy makes a melee attack against this creature, impose 1 Bane on that attack roll. Requires a held melee weapon. Against an NPC attack, grant 1 Boon to the single defense roll instead. Applies to this attack only; it does not grant a counterattack.

Creature procedure · @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.da-rules.JournalEntry.fcfeb03f877503a3.JournalEntryPage.743fa3bd946d24fb]{Monster ability index}

A needle catches the skin, and a bitter numbness spreads from the puncture.

Rules

ID: monster-venom

Action: Main Action

Use the printed attack. Standard also applies Poisoned 1; Strong applies Poisoned 2. Poisoned gives Banes, not additional HP damage, and follows ordinary decay. No second resistance roll.

Limits: Only creatures whose entries list this ability possess it. Printed entry values and restrictions apply; no ability grants unlisted actions.

Creature procedure · @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.da-rules.JournalEntry.fcfeb03f877503a3.JournalEntryPage.743fa3bd946d24fb]{Monster ability index}

A warm light settles over one companion like a hand on the shoulder.

Rules

ID: monster-warding-light

Action: Maneuver

One willing ally within 3 squares reduces Frightened by 1. Until this creature’s next turn, that ally also has 1 Boon on its next defense against a mental attack; for an NPC ally, impose 1 Bane on that player attack. Consumed even if canceled; does not stack with itself.

Only creatures whose entries list this ability possess it. Printed limits apply.

The bear’s roar fills the space between itself and its cubs.

Rules

ID: monster-brown-bear-warning-bellow

One hearing creature within 3 squares gains Frightened 1 of the bear; once per turn.

Limits: Costs its Maneuver; no extra action is granted.

Rules

ID: monster-warning-hiss

Action: Reaction

Creature procedure · @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.da-rules.JournalEntry.fcfeb03f877503a3.JournalEntryPage.743fa3bd946d24fb]{Monster ability index}

Its features soften and settle into a face it has studied.

Rules

ID: monster-assumed-face

Action: Maneuver

Copy the appearance and voice of one observed person of the same Size until dismissed or reduced to 0 HP. Keep its own statistics and equipment; gain no memories, languages or powers. Suspicious examination uses a player Reason roll when consequences warrant one.

Only creatures whose entries list this ability possess it. Printed limits apply.

Creature procedure · @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.da-rules.JournalEntry.fcfeb03f877503a3.JournalEntryPage.743fa3bd946d24fb]{Monster ability index}

Roots braid themselves into firm footholds across the treacherous ground.

Rules

ID: monster-root-bridge

Action: Maneuver

Choose up to 3 connected difficult-terrain ground squares within 3 squares; they count as normal terrain until its next turn. Requires soil or living vegetation; cannot bridge empty space or bypass occupied squares.

Only creatures whose entries list this ability possess it. Printed limits apply.

Creature procedure · @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.da-rules.JournalEntry.fcfeb03f877503a3.JournalEntryPage.743fa3bd946d24fb]{Monster ability index}

White strands snap between the pillars and tighten around boots and wrists.

Rules

ID: monster-web-cast

Action: Main Action

A printed web attack applies Slowed 1/2/3 on Weak/Standard/Strong, without damage. The strands decay normally. The target or an adjacent helper can spend Main to remove 1 Slowed from this source; fire damage to the target removes all of it after resolving that damage. Webbing is not a free, one-sided grapple.

Limits: Only creatures whose entries list this ability possess it. Printed entry values and restrictions apply; no ability grants unlisted actions.

Creature procedure · @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.da-rules.JournalEntry.fcfeb03f877503a3.JournalEntryPage.743fa3bd946d24fb]{Monster ability index}

The body uncoils into a ribbon of air and gathers at the edge of the gust.

Rules

ID: monster-wind-step

Action: Maneuver

Move up to 3 squares using a printed movement mode without provoking from one visible enemy chosen before moving. Pay normal terrain costs and provoke normally from other enemies. Cannot pass through solid objects or occupied squares.

Only creatures whose entries list this ability possess it. Printed limits apply.

Creature procedure · @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.da-rules.JournalEntry.fcfeb03f877503a3.JournalEntryPage.743fa3bd946d24fb]{Monster ability index}

Great wings beat downward, throwing loose earth into every nearby face.

Rules

ID: monster-wing-beat

Action: Maneuver

Choose one adjacent creature. It becomes Slowed 1 until its normal decay removes it. No damage or roll. This is not a push, extra movement or a free attack. Once per turn; immunity to Slowed applies. The narrative dust does not also blind anyone.

Limits: Only creatures whose entries list this ability possess it. Printed entry values and restrictions apply; no ability grants unlisted actions.

Creature procedure · @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.da-rules.JournalEntry.fcfeb03f877503a3.JournalEntryPage.743fa3bd946d24fb]{Monster ability index}

A single hard wingbeat carries it toward a better angle.

Rules

ID: monster-wing-step

Action: Maneuver

Move up to 2 squares using its printed fly speed without provoking from one visible enemy chosen before moving. Pay normal terrain costs and provoke normally from other enemies. This grants no attack, automatic lift of another creature or hovering exception.

Only creatures whose entries list this ability possess it. Printed limits apply.

Creature procedure · @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.da-rules.JournalEntry.fcfeb03f877503a3.JournalEntryPage.743fa3bd946d24fb]{Monster ability index}

Original HOL creature capabilities. These are separate from learned character abilities: no DP, no player Discipline requirements, no automatic access from an animal form or a summoning category. Each creature supplies its own attack values. Shared attack templates describe attacker outcomes for authoring; the DA creature card prints the corresponding defense outcomes explicitly. The player reference prints attacker outcomes. Never ask the DA to convert a template’s result during play.

The creature entry prints complete action rules. Per-creature outcomes are authoritative where they specialize a shared template.

Reuse an existing capability when its trigger, target, effect and limits fit. Creature-specific descriptive text may change its presentation without creating another mechanical ability. Different anatomy can express the same rule: Clinging Recoil works for a corpse's clutch, adhesive flesh or slime. New templates should add a meaningful option rather than rename an existing effect. See the complete action and trope review for assignments, deliberate omissions and the limits of its CV estimates.

Summoned Form Reference

Heroes of Legend · Dungeon Architect’s Guide & Bestiary

Use these 73 player profiles when a summoning card permits the listed category and tier. A familiar name, a low CV or membership in a creature family does not provide eligibility by itself. Follow the summoning card's placement and duration.

Each profile prints the form's attributes, permitted actions and attacker outcomes. The controlling player handles its rolls. These profiles differ deliberately from the DA creature cards: a summon has no independent activity, Reactions or opportunity attacks. The initial free Main command counts as its one command for that turn.

A form cannot be healed. At 0 HP, beyond its six-square tether, or when its controller becomes unconscious or dies, it disappears. Its energy nature grants no unprinted immunity or incorporeality. Existing conditions and durations still resolve on its controller's turn even when no command is issued.

The category and tier index precedes the profiles. When a summoned healer acts, its controller pays the printed HP cost once, before resolution, bypassing resistance and remaining above 0; use the form's own attribute and outcomes.

Condition reference

The full condition table follows in the assembled manuscript. A condition's number may mean severity, duration or both. Temporary numbered effects resolve at turn end, then decay by 1. An asterisk prevents automatic decay. Maintained Grappled and binary conditions use their own removal rules.

Use a plausible Main Action to reduce Bleeding, Burning or Freezing by 1 on yourself or an adjacent creature. This is not a universal condition-removal action. Matching resistance applies to Burning and Freezing; Bleeding bypasses it.

Dazed and Grappled restrict category selection at turn start without undoing spent actions. Use the greater restriction when they coexist. Paralyzed, Asleep and Unconscious impose their immediate restrictions. Helpless-state defense Banes apply once when several such states overlap.

Wound reference

The five complete wound tables follow the conditions. They retain all 280 authored results and their recovery values. Use chapter 8 for the wound roll, table choice, applicability fallback and survival procedure. The table's remedy states which lasting effects it removes; immediate displacement and temporary conditions do not recur merely because a scar remains.
